propositions: Four LLM code review advisories on merged Gerrit 1704 (f8e6a2507f) drain lock implementation require closure: one design decision and three quality gaps

The reclaim-window TOCTOU in _acquire_advisory_lock between stamped_file_is_stale verdict and os.unlink lacks exclusion and permits concurrent drains, but harm is bounded to redundant work and the queue claim remains the correctness boundary

_describe_drain_lock_holder collapses incomplete v2 stamps into 'unstamped' while doctor_locks._existence_report distinguishes 'incomplete ownership stamp', causing two surfaces describing the same artifact to disagree
The drain row's unrecognised and incomplete ownership stamp descriptions in doctor_locks._existence_report have no test coverage
The stamp-write-failure branch in _acquire_advisory_lock where os.write raises, logs a WARNING, but still returns the fd is untested and lacks validation that the lock remains ceiling-bounded
